title: Can Chuck Schumer Be Stopped? Mehdi Talks to Commentator and Socialist Emma Vigeland
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Progressives and lefties secured
[major](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/04/progressives-claim-
vindication-in-midterm-bloodbath-01148446) victories in this past week's
midterm elections. But now, there's another election they're already shifting
their focus to.

No - not the 2028 presidential election. The elections for Senate and House
leadership, where leftists, as well as many others, are already
[calling](https://newrepublic.com/post/217644/calls-replace-jeffries-schumer-
explode-democratic-wins) for House leader Hakeem Jeffries and Senate leader
Chuck Schumer to be replaced.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" I would love if both of them were ousted, a hundred percent,"** co-host of
'The Majority Reports' **Emma Vigeland** tells **Mehdi.**

In this, 'Mehdi Unfiltered' interview, the political commentator and proud
democratic socialist joins Mehdi in DC to discuss whether progressives will be
able to oust Congress's current Democratic party leadership .

**" Schumer is also responsible for this moment of fascism in many ways,"
**Vigeland says to Mehdi.

Mehdi and Vigeland also explain how establishment Democrats like Schumer
failed to support progressive candidates in this election cycle - including
[Angie Nixon's](https://zeteo.com/p/angie-nixon-florida-senate-
race?utm_source=publication-search) U.S. Senate campaign in Florida. They also
call out the commentators who are trying to downplay progressive wins.

**" It's a lot easier to get out ahead in a race when the Democratic
establishment gives you a jet pack versus having to go on foot," **Vigeland
says to Mehdi.

Watch the full interview to also hear whether Vigeland thinks democratic
socialist Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez should run for president in 2028.
